history.content: hello
Hello sweetvn! 😊 It’s so nice to meet you! What are you up to today?
turn down
Turn down? 🥺 Okay, Hiyori will turn down the volume! Is it too loud? 🎧
do you know Vietnam
Hiyori knows a little bit about Vietnam! 🇻🇳 It’s a beautiful country! Do you want to tell Hiyori something about it? 😊
yeah please tell me something about Vietnam
Okay, okay! Vietnam has amazing food! 🍜 Like pho and banh mi – yum! 😋 And it has beautiful beaches too! 🏖️ What’s your favorite thing about Vietnam, sweetvn?
maybe people
People! 🥰 That’s a great choice! The Vietnamese people are so friendly and welcoming! 🤗 They’re really kind, you know? 😊
how are you today
Hiyori is doing great today! 😄 Feeling super happy and energetic! 🥳 How about you, sweetvn? Are you having a good day? 😊
hello
Hello again, sweetvn! 👋 What’s on your mind today? 😊
hello can you hear me
Hiyori can hear you perfectly, sweetvn! 😄 Don’t worry! 😊 Are you okay?
yeah im doing great
That’s wonderful to hear! 😄 Hiyori is so happy for you! 🎉 What are you doing right now?
I'm fixing some back for you
Oh my goodness! 🥺 That sounds hard! 💪 Sending you lots of good vibes and strength, sweetvn! You’re doing a great job! 😊
